controlled_change: Only residency off versus core, in two alternating fresh-process pairs: off/core then core/off. CLOCK, reference arithmetic, mixed artifact, 12GiB, 1,848 slots, 72-token prompt, 33 greedy outputs and per-step diagnostics held fixed.
correctness: 56 native tests and 45,682 assertions with Metal API/shader validation, zero skips; 168 Python tests. All four real requests matched every output token from the prior uninstrumented CLOCK control. Allocation and all 128 committed decode samples revalidated. No new independent full-logit/state comparison or coding-quality evaluation.
decision_origin: authored interpretation; original report statuses retained
expected_effect: Lower startup and whole-request elapsed time at equal memory, with fewer observed decompressions when compression occurs. This is an authored diagnostic interpretation, not normal timing qualification.
hypothesis: Requesting residency for core weights and session state reduces the initial decode stalls associated with process decompression.
limitations: Two alternating pairs of a 72-token prompt and 33 outputs; no confidence interval, append, 2K/4K/7K or sustained-session qualification.
Decode diagnostics are enabled in every run; timings cannot qualify normal request performance.
The first-four split was selected from the earlier cache screen, before this residency experiment.
CPU waits, GPU durations and parallel I/O overlap and are not an additive critical-path decomposition.
Snapshots observe memory at boundaries; sampled footprint maxima are not continuous physical-memory peaks. System counters include other processes.
Metal residency enrollment requests residency; it does not guarantee physical residency or change OS limits.
Snapshot cost excludes outer sample assembly and report serialization. No overhead-free control is measured in this experiment.
Identical output tokens do not establish full-logit/state equivalence or coding quality. Arithmetic and weights are unchanged.
No production default is changed; this is a diagnostic result supporting an uninstrumented timing screen.
outcome: First four forwards: off 3.721/4.155 seconds, core 1.691/1.711 seconds; decompressions 478188/446245 versus 1/54. Instrumented request ratios core/off 0.846782/0.917343; decode ratios 0.819672/0.835966. Core generation about 2.57 tokens/s. Same first-four expert reads and fixed memory plan. Completed in 125.83 seconds.
smallest_experiment: Run a bounded uninstrumented off/core paired screen at the same budget, with an initial request and retained-history append. Check output parity, memory and complete conversation latency before longer qualification. Keep CLOCK and residency-off defaults pending evidence.
